description: Step 2 of the fz-sc8.197 page (version 3). 'extern "C" def integer + integer :: integer, as: fz_op_add_ii, raises: ...' is a clause of +/2: its declared parameter types are the clause's type test and its spec, and the selected clause is the extern. Convert the 98 one-line forwarders in lib/. The swapped-argument clauses get their own runtime entries (fz_op_*_fi). The splice's forwarder test is deleted: the question becomes 'the callee is an extern'. Measured in a spike: 46 forwarder executables leave the distiller's program; typed heads already compile identically to guards of type tests. Signal: backend program identical to step 1 except the forwarders are gone.

comments.text:
Survey done (read-only, branch fz-sc8.197/splice). Facts that shape the design: extern is parsed by its own parser (frontdoor.rs parse_extern_item): defp only, identifier names only, options are the fixed sequence raises:/message:, the C symbol is always the fz name (extern_symbol_from_name); an extern item is its own one-form group with zero clauses (BodyShape::Extern, about 30 branches); @spec already parses infix heads; typed heads become row preconditions (surface_pattern_rows); a caller keys a callee activation and the callee's analysis picks reachable clauses (calculate_dispatch_reachability over the EntryDispatch fact). lib: 24 functions are only forwarders (35 clauses), 28 mix forwarders with ordinary clauses (about 58 forwarder clauses + 2 that swap arguments), about 95 forwarder clauses in all. README.md and guides/externs.html show 'extern "C" def' which the parser rejects.
Design in two stages. Stage 1, surface: an extern head is a clause of its function group whose parameters are typed by the declaration and whose body is a call to a hidden private extern named by as:. Everything downstream is unchanged. Signal: backend dump identical to today's for the converted lib (the X4 method).
Stage 2, selection: at a call site, when the argument types select exactly one clause and it is an extern head, the call resolves to the extern itself; no activation of the forwarder exists. Experiment E-select before building, predictions written now: distiller jobs fall 2-3.6% (of 12,855), executables fall by 46 or more (of 1,375), fz2 build instructions fall 0.5-3%, run instructions within noise (0.2%) of the splice, stdout identical, and BackendExecutable::forwards_to finds no spliced site left that goes through a forwarder except the two swapped clauses.

E-select RESULT (spike behind FZ_SPIKE_SELECT in resolve_function_call; patch scratch select/spike-select.patch; distiller on #600). Builder figures, then my re-run.
Jobs 12,824 -> 12,505 (-2.49%; predicted -2 to -3.6%: HIT). Executables 1,370 -> 1,280 (-90; predicted -46 or more: HIT; 49 are forwarders, 41 not accounted for). fz2 build instructions -0.83 to -1.31% over three pairs; my re-run 19.484G -> 19.281G (-1.04%) (predicted -0.5 to -3%: HIT, low end). Run instructions -0.05/-0.07%; my re-run 22.146G -> 22.157G (+0.05%) (predicted within 0.2%: HIT). Stdout identical to reference (mine too).
209 call sites selected. 5 forwarders remain: Kernel.<> with an any argument (run-time test remains; correct), String.Chars.{Float,Integer}.to_string via the protocol path (semantic.rs ~2094 calls prepare_function_call directly), one lambda.
Not checked by the spike: the lowered tail still names the function, so static call edges/demand/transport still read the forwarder; AnalyzeActivation +8 and DeriveRecursive +12 not traced; no tests run.

title: A clause can be declared as the extern it is (extern heads)
